article.story: COLLEGE PARK, Md. -- — Oluchi Okananwa scored 17 points, Nunu Agara scored 12 points and grabbed 10 rebounds and No. 18 Maryland beat Monmouth 86-53 on Tuesday night. Maryland (5-1) has won five straight since its 101-93 season-opening loss to No. 1 South Carolina at Adidas Arena in Paris. Monmouth (5-2) had its three-game win streak snapped. Both of the Hawks' losses this season came against Big Ten opponents, including a 64-62 defeat at Rutgers on Mia Pauldo's jumper in the closing seconds. Vanessa McManus made a layup that pulled the Hawks within five points about 1 1/2 minutes into the second half, but they got no closer. Monmouth committed nine turnovers and was 0 for 4 from the field as the Terrapins scored 29 of the next 30 points to take 64-31 lead with 4 minutes left in the third quarter. Divine Dibula had 20 points on 8-of-9 shooting to go with seven rebounds, two steals and a block but committed seven of the Hawks' 23 turnovers. The Terrapins shot 40% from the field and hit just 6 of 25 (24%) from 3-point range, but outscored Monmouth 24-5 from the free-throw line. Maryland had 52-30 rebounding advantage, finished plus-12 on the offensive glass and outscored the Hawks 18-8 in second-chance points. Up next Monmouth: Hosts Fairleigh Dickinson on Saturday. Maryland: Plays Saturday at Towson. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
